description:
Kids Kick Scooter, LED Lighted Wheels and 3 Adjustable Height Handlebars, Lean-to-Steer & Widen Anti-Slip Deck, 3 Wheel Scooter for Boys & Girls Ages 2-8 and up to 100 Lbs

【2-In-1 Design】 The unique design of this scooter allows your kids comfortably scoot sitting or standing up, the removable flip-up seat makes it easy to switch between kicking and scooting modes.

【Adjustable Handlebar】The handlebar is comfortable, non-slip and easy to hold. There are 3 different heights for the handlebar. This accommodates usage for children as they grow older.

【Lean-to-Steer】The Lean-to-Steer Technology makes kids easy to control the ride rather than turning the handlebars. It is help kids develop balance and coordination during riding.

【Safety and stable】3 wheels for stability, your child will be able to balance with ease, the wide anti-slip deck and rear wrap brake ensure your child’s safety while riding.

【Colorful Light】The 3 wheels will light up in different of twinkling colors when rolling the scooter. It can stimulate kids’ interest and get more fun. No batteries required

【Easy to carry】This scooter is easy to install and fold, light enough to carry, fits in the trunk of a car, and fairly easy to store. A great gift for your kid.
